item.title: Watch How Whalefall Brought Its Visceral Whale Stomach Survival Thriller to Life
item.description: The star of this year's Resident Evil adaptation endured another horrific experience in the thriller Whalefall in October, which put actor Austin Abrams inside the belly of a 60-ton sperm whale in a fight for survival. While that situation sounds harrowing in real life, filming scenes simulating being inside a whale's stomach also looks exhausting. In a new exclusive clip from Whalefall , viewers get a peek behind the scenes at what Abrams experienced , as more than a dozen stomach puppeteers recreated the visceral action of being digested — all while your host is being attacked by killer whales.

item.title: Please, GTA 6, Give Us More of Jason’s Favorite Gay Romantasy Series
item.description: Jason Duval is a pretty quiet guy, as far as Grand Theft Auto protagonists go, but there's more to this character than meets the eye, including his love of books. In Grand Theft Auto 6 , players will find several books scattered around Jason and Lucia's home in Key Lento, such as Ashes of Glory , Lethal by Design , and Orca, A Whole Different Animal . They can interact with each book to add it to their collection. Unfortunately, they can't pick up The Battle for Zantoroth , the book on his nightstand.

item.title: 24 Years Later, Star Trek's Most Controversial Movie Is Officially Free on Streaming
item.description: Saying goodbye to beloved television characters is never easy. After spending years getting to know them, audiences have expectations about how their stories should end. Some get the send offs they deserve, while others leave fans wondering what might have been. Unfortunately, 2002's Star Trek: Nemesis falls into the latter category, bringing an unceremonious end to the big-screen adventures of the Next Generation crew.

item.title: Rust Will Officially Introduce Premium Paid Service With a Most-Requested Feature
item.description: In August, Facepunch removed the controversial Battle Pass system entry from this year's Rust roadmap. It was replaced with Rust Premium, a status that grants players who have at least $15 worth of items in their inventory access to premium servers , but not much else. This month's force wipe patch notes unveiled some additional details about the changes coming to Rust Premium "soon." As it turns out, Rust Premium will become a paid monthly service with exclusive perks and rewards.

item.title: Wizards of the Coast's War Against MTG Proxies Isn't as Bad as It Sounds
item.description: Wizards of the Coast, a Hasbro subsidiary and the publisher of popular tabletop games Magic: The Gathering and Dungeons & Dragons , has filed a massive lawsuit against a provider of proxy Magic cards, PrintMTG Enterprise, seeking more than $28.6 million in damages .

item.title: 72 Years Later, Lord of the Rings Officially Reveals How Sauron Made the One Ring
item.description: "A theme throughout the earlier seasons of this show is the idea that creation requires sacrifice," series co-creator Patrick McKay tells Polygon. "One of Sauron's challenges this season is that he needs to learn what that means. He needs to actually be willing to sacrifice something. But that also means that maybe there's a part of himself he can't get back after that."

item.title: Forget 'Blade Runner 2099,' Ridley Scott's Sci-Fi Survival Masterpiece Is Already on Streaming
item.description: The long-awaited Blade Runner 2099 arrives on Prime Video tonight at 9 p.m. Eastern time , which, frankly, feels a bit late at night to drop eight episodes the night before a major holiday. Executive produced by original Blade Runner director Ridley Scott, the sequel series takes place in a future Los Angeles where the replicants have taken over and demoted humans to second-class citizens. It’s the kind of show that looks like it deserves a dedicated, fully alert , all-day binge session, not to be drowsily cut short so you can wake up early enough to begin preparing the stuffing tomorrow.

item.title: 7 Funniest MST3K Episodes to Watch For Your Personal Turkey Day Marathon
item.description: Mystery Science Theater 3000 fans have always had a special relationship with American Thanksgiving. The show originally premiered on Thanksgiving Day in 1988, back in its public access era on KTMA TV in Minneapolis. Three years later, Comedy Central ran the first "Turkey Day" MST3K marathon, as both an anniversary celebration for the show and a 30-hour Thanksgiving special.

item.title: GTA 6's Most Heartbreaking Scene Is Exactly Why You Had To Do All Those Chores
item.description: Jason repairs the steps leading up to his and Lucia’s home, fixes a railing, buys groceries, orders flowers, paints the walls of their bedroom, and more to prepare for Lucia’s arrival from prison. All those chores might seem less thrilling than the opening hours you’d expect in a big-budget action game. But it turns out they set up a tragic heartbreak I simply did not see coming.
